card.name: Subject just before 'not evaluated/known'
card.fires_on: The last word of a subject phrase in label text, right before a statement that something has not been evaluated, is not known or could not be assessed. It fires on the noun or verb where the model expects a negation of knowledge.

modes.label: Subject before 'has not been evaluated'
modes.description: A noun ending a claim about an interaction or effect, just before it is said to be unstudied.
modes.example: The effect of cyclosporine on diltiazem plasma<< concentrations>> has not been evaluated.

modes.label: Time span before 'could not be assessed'
modes.description: A duration beyond the studied period, followed by a statement that risk could not be assessed.
modes.example: the risk of suicidal thoughts or behavior beyond 24<< weeks>> could not be assessed

card.writes: It promotes words meaning not yet, unknown or unclear, so the text goes on to say the matter is unknown or unstudied.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a label is about to say that something is unknown or was not studied.
